newsitem.title: USA: Hewlett-Packard says cuts prices 13 pct.
newsitem.headline: Hewlett-Packard says cuts prices 13 pct.

text.p: Hewlett-Packard Co said Monday it cut list prices by up to 13 percent on its small-business and commercial HP Vectra PC and HP OmniBook notebook PC lines in the United States and Canada.
The new prices are effective immediately.
HP said it cut prices by up to 10 percent on its OmniBook 5700 and 800 notebook PCs.
The list price of theOmniBook 5700 CTX now is $5,750 and is expected to sell for about $5,175. The company said that price is 17 percent below a comparable Compaq Armada 7750 PC.
The company also said the price of a commercial HP Vectra VL PC has been cut by 13 percent to $2,059 and is expected to sell for about $1,845.
The price of an HP Vectra 525 MCx 5/166M designed for small businesses, cut almost 11 percent, is now $2,009 and is expected to sell for about $1,826.
